title: feat(plugin-list): list-view publishes the spec keys its renderer honours on a page node (objectui#13047)
body:
Fixes #13047
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

`@objectstack/spec` 18 gave `list-view` a `ComponentPropsMap` row (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22444), the list view's own `ListViewSchema`, and PR #13043 booked the 38 keys of that row the registration did not publish, plus 6 member pins, as OWED to this card (objectui#11111 decision 3 = B).

Each of the 38 keys was measured on a page node: authored in the node's `properties`, rendered through the real `SchemaRenderer` and the real `list-view` registration, and asserted at what it draws, what it queries, or what it hands the child view that draws it. Every row has a control that differs only by that key. Every fixture is first parsed by the spec's own `list-view` row.

- **Published (33):** `pagination`, `searchableFields`, `label`, `description`, `userFilters`, `userActions`, `compactToolbar`, `appearance`, `exportOptions`, `allowPrinting`, `showRecordCount`, `emptyState`, `hiddenFields`, `fieldOrder`, `rowHeight`, `resizable`, `selection`, `navigation`, `grouping`, `rowColor`, `conditionalFormatting`, `inlineEdit`, `rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `bulkActionDefs`, `kanban`, `calendar`, `gantt`, `gallery`, `timeline`, `map`, `tree`, `chart`. Each description names the spec's member shape. `label` / `description` declare both I18nLabel arms; the array keys whose contract admits one member kind declare `of`.
- **Unpublished by measurement (5)**, each recorded in the parity gate's `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` with its reason:
  - `name`: read by nothing on a page node (same query, same DOM, same grid node with and without it).
  - `requiredPermissions`: no audience gate on this block; a capability nobody holds still draws and queries the list.
  - `sharing`: draws a Share button with no click handler; nothing enforces the config.
  - `addRecord`: draws an Add button that calls the host's `onAddRecord`, and a page node has no host to pass one, so the click does nothing.
  - `filterableFields`: the row declares it as the legacy shorthand of `userFilters.fields`; the list draws no quick-filter bar from it and reads it as the Filter panel's field list instead.
- **One inert member, published with the key that carries it:** `appearance.allowedVisualizations` narrows the view switcher, which a page node does not draw (`showViewSwitcher` is a host prop, not a row key), so an authored `type` still draws. `appearance.showDescription` acts, so the key is published and its description says the member does nothing on a page.

`list-view` and the `view:list` alias (same renderer) now share one input list, `LIST_VIEW_INPUTS`. The descriptions of the six keys already published are filled in. No reader, prop, export or type member is added; nothing changes at render time.

## Ledger

In `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`:

- The 38 `list-view` OWED rows in `UNPUBLISHED_EXEMPTIONS` and the 6 in `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` are struck.
- `OBJECTUI_11111_LEDGER_CAPS.unpublishedKeys` 38 to 0, `memberPins` 6 to 0, the per-owner total for objectui#13047 44 to 0, `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING` 6 to 0.
- The `OWED_TO` / `owedEntries` helpers left with their last entries. The comment where they stood says a future bump writes them back.
- `MEMBER_PINS` gains 33 `list-view` entries: the 6 booked (`data`, `columns`, `filter`, `sort`, `options` in the new file; `dataSource` in `ListView.elementDataSource.test.tsx`, read end to end), and one for every structured key published.

## Measurement level, said plainly

`plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban` and the other view packages are not dependencies of `plugin-list`, so the child views are stand-ins that record the node `ListView` builds, as every other test in this package does. For the grid's row keys and each kind's own block, the measurement is the hand-off: the member reaches the node of the view that draws it, on the page path. What each child view draws from its own node is pinned in that view's package under its own published key. The toolbar, query and chrome keys are measured at the DOM or the adapter's query.

## Tests (all at `215edf59d5`)

- `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047.test.tsx` (new): 49 passed.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`: 260 passed.
- Family runs through `os-verify-lock`, `--maxWorkers=1`:
  - the 12 plugin-list files that import the registration: 130 passed;
  - 8 console registry/manifest files: 443 passed;
  - 3 app-shell block-config / page-block files: 68 passed;
  - 3 sdui-parser files: 130 passed.
- `type-check`: `@object-ui/plugin-list` (both projects; `--listFilesOnly` shows the test project compiles the new file) and `@object-ui/console`, each exit 0 after a turbo build of its dependency closure.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 3 changed source files: 0 errors (3 pre-existing `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on the barrel's export line). The root config enables no type-aware linting, so the change cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is declared to CI.
- Gate battery: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` and `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` all exit 0. `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with `no-artifact` (it wants a whole-workspace build), as it does on main.
- The full `packages/plugin-list` and `apps/console` directories are declared to CI.

## Ablation (the parity gate can fail)

`allowPrinting`'s input line was deleted from `packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx` with `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `2ed1ea1932b1` to `780b8c1b9265`). The parity file then went red on exactly one test: `list-view publishes every top-level key its spec props schema declares`, `expected [ 'allowPrinting' ] to deeply equal []` (1 failed, 259 passed). The tool restored the file, and the restore was checked by blob hash: `git hash-object` = `HEAD:packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx` = `2ed1ea1932b1`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The alias resolves `@object-ui/plugin-list` to `src`, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

Renderer gaps the seat may card (not built here, per the dispatch):

- `requiredPermissions` on a page `list-view`: the record blocks gate on it and this block does not.
- `addRecord` on a page `list-view`: the Add button needs a host `onAddRecord` that a page node never has.

A contract question on `filterableFields`: the row calls it the shorthand of `userFilters.fields`, and the renderer reads it as the Filter panel whitelist. Either the spec describes it wrong or the renderer reads it wrong; that is the seat's call.

`sharing` draws a Share button with no handler wherever `ListView` renders, the object list page included. Not measured on that page here.
